coupons_duration_cycles_consistency.name: coupons_duration_cycles_consistency
coupons_duration_cycles_consistency.value: ("coupons"."discount_scope" = 'fixed_duration' AND "coupons"."discount_duration_cycles" IS NOT NULL) OR ("coupons"."discount_scope" != 'fixed_duration' AND "coupons"."discount_duration_cycles" IS NULL)

payments_kind_parent_consistency.name: payments_kind_parent_consistency
payments_kind_parent_consistency.value: ("payments"."kind" = 'charge' AND "payments"."parent_payment_id" IS NULL) OR ("payments"."kind" = 'refund' AND "payments"."parent_payment_id" IS NOT NULL)
